req.title: Task deletion persists
req.statement: The system shall remove deleted rows so subsequent GET returns 404 for that id.

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that a deleted task should not be retrievable, ensuring data consistency and integrity. The test suite includes a positive test to confirm successful deletion, a negative test to handle non-existent task deletion, and a boundary test to check behavior at the edge of valid task IDs.

tests.name: test_delete_existing_task
preconditions: Task with id 1 exists in the database
expected: Subsequent GET request to /tasks/1 returns HTTP 404
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

# Delete existing task
response = client.delete('/tasks/1')
assert response.status_code == 204

# Verify task is deleted
response = client.get('/tasks/1')
assert response.status_code == 404

tests.name: test_delete_non_existent_task
preconditions: Task with id 999 does not exist in the database
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

# Attempt to delete non-existent task
response = client.delete('/tasks/999')
assert response.status_code == 404

tests.name: test_delete_task_boundary_id
preconditions: Task with id 20 exists in the database
expected: Subsequent GET request to /tasks/20 returns HTTP 404
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

# Delete task at boundary id
response = client.delete('/tasks/20')
assert response.status_code == 204

# Verify task is deleted
response = client.get('/tasks/20')
assert response.status_code == 404
